messages:
ingrid: Hey @support — we hit a recurring issue where streaming tool-call args arrive as partial JSON and the function call fails validation. Happening in us-east behind our edge gateway. ReqID: req_0x8f9a. Minimal repro and logs below.

ingrid: ```
# client (curl) opens SSE and streams a tool call in chunks
curl -N -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-...\" https://api.redwood.example/stream
# stream payload (sent in multiple writes by client):
data: {"id":"inv-123","tool":"message.send","args":{"recipient":"alice","body":"Meeting at 3pm - bring the report","metadata":{"project":"q2"}}}
# but what arrives to the parser is: (truncated)
data: {"id":"inv-123","tool":"message.send","args":{"recipient":"alice","body":"Meeting at 3pm - bring the rep
```

ingrid: Server error: \"schema validation failed: args must be full JSON\". Attached server log snippet: ```
ERROR req_0x8f9a json parse error: Expecting value: line 1 column 198 (char 197)
  File \"/app/stream_parser.py\", line 142, in parse_event
    payload = json.loads(event.data)
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value
```

james: Thanks @ingrid — sorry you're blocked. Can you paste the full curl -v request/response and the exact client library/version? Also share the edge gateway id in the response headers (x-edge-id or x-gw-id). Any chance a proxy is doing gzip or buffering?

maria: +1. My initial suspicion: SSE chunk boundaries are splitting a JSON object in the middle. Some HTTP proxies (or LBs) flush partial packets (keepalive/heartbeat) which can cause the SSE client to emit multiple data events for one logical JSON. If our parser assumes one data event == complete JSON, that will explode.

maria: Quick checklist:
- Does client send Content-Encoding: gzip? compression can force flushes.
- Is Transfer-Encoding: chunked present on the response path?
- Any intermediate L7 proxy that manipulates streaming? (aws-alb/nginx/gcp-https-proxy)
- Are SSE 'data:' frames being concatenated or split by a heartbeat implementation?

james: If you can reproduce, please capture a short pcap of the HTTP stream or provide a curl -v output. Also include the raw streamed body as we see it at the gateway (we have logging for req bodies if you give the req id).

ingrid: curl -v snippet (sanitized):
```
> GET /stream HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.redwood.example
> Accept: text/event-stream
> Authorization: Bearer sk-...
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< content-type: text/event-stream
< transfer-encoding: chunked
< x-edge-id: gw-7b
# then client writes chunks, edge forwards with chunked encoding, but chunks split JSON mid-object
```

ingrid: attaching a small pcap to the ticket (will upload to the thread in a moment). Also noticed customers that retry on parse failure end up creating duplicate downstream calls which triggered billing noise.

maria: Thanks — that matches the pattern I saw in a previous incident. Short-term mitigation: ask clients to ensure each SSE 'data:' record contains a complete JSON object (i.e., send one complete JSON per data event). Longer-term fix: we'll make the stream parser resilient by buffering across SSE data events and attempting reassembly until a syntactically complete JSON is detected (match braces or use a streaming JSON parser). I'll open a priority ticket.

maria: Hotfix plan:
- Add lightweight reassembly for tool-call parsing (non-blocking, limited buffer) — target: 48h for a staged rollout to canary.
- Instrument edge to log SSE data boundaries for suspicious reqs.
- Add a compatibility note to docs recommending that clients avoid mid-message flushes or use envelope framing (length-prefix) for streaming tool calls.

james: Possible customer workaround if you can't change client immediately: set the client to send Content-Length per call (if using HTTP/1.1 non-streaming) or switch to batched non-streaming endpoint. For SSE specifically, ensure the client writes the full JSON then a newline and double newline to terminate the event.

ingrid: I'll run a small repro that disables gzip on the client and re-run. Uploading pcap now. Also please confirm whether we will credit the duplicated charges while we investigate — it's affecting the customer's billing reconciliation.

james: We'll flag the billing impact and pause auto-charges for that customer while we triage. Please DM me the customer account id.

deploy-bot: :eyes: created ticket RDW-3819 assigned to maria (eng-oncall) — tracking SSE reassembly and telemetry.

maria: Thanks @ingrid — once we have the pcap and the gateway logs (x-edge-id gw-7b + req_0x8f9a) I'll reproduce locally. Also could you try a tiny repro with netcat/socat to show the exact chunk boundaries? Example quick test: send the JSON in two writes to replicate the split.

ingrid: Will do and report back. Really appreciate the quick triage. :thumbsup:
